findings.summary: Advertised graph ops have all-optional Params, LogicalPath-only endpoints, and no result-unit/cycle/path-selection/universe law.
counterexamples: two fact2 A→B different provenance: unique subject vs two relationship rows
one Run, two TS universes, same src/a.ts: path-only subject is ambiguous
schema admits graph.path with empty params and snapshot-only view

findings.summary: Cursor is unbound; latest may be re-resolved across pages; response View reuses request aliases including latest.
counterexamples: page1 latest→Run A [a,c] returns a; page2 latest+cursor after Run B [b,c] can return B's second row

findings.summary: Query coverage=complete must not mint no-callers from zero stored edges. Graph ops are not advisory.
counterexamples: complete stored-call traversal empty while unresolved dynamic incoming remains unknown
advisory=true on graph response is schema-admitted, not cross-joined

proposedMinimalLaws.endpoint: {universe, kind, nativeSubjectId} (+ packageManifestPath for packages); LogicalPath-only ambiguous → REQUEST.PRECONDITION_FAILED / QUERY.ENDPOINT_AMBIGUOUS
proposedMinimalLaws.neighborsUnit: one row per distinct fact2, order (source subject3, target subject3, fact2)
proposedMinimalLaws.pathUnit: one shortest simple fact2 sequence; ties by fact2 id sequence
proposedMinimalLaws.reachUnit: distinct evaluation-subjects; start excluded unless includeStart=true
proposedMinimalLaws.view: request may resolve latest/snapshot; graph.* response ResolvedView is {runId} only
proposedMinimalLaws.cursor: opaque host bind of projectId+runId+factViewSelection+operation+effectiveParams+order+position; never re-resolve latest; mismatch QUERY.CURSOR_MISMATCH
proposedMinimalLaws.totalItems: produced result-unit count under the bound selection, not page size or claimed universe cardinality
